title: Connectedness and maximality of point components
statement: Let $X$ be any topological space, with connectedness as in [def-weil-connected-scheme], also applied to subsets with their subspace topology. For $x\in X$, define $C_x$ to be the union of all connected subsets of $X$ containing $x$. Then $x\in C_x$ and $C_x$ is connected. Every connected subset $S\subseteq X$ containing $x$ satisfies $S\subseteq C_x$. No separation or local connectedness hypothesis is required.
